Events

The snow report below is updated each morning during the ski season and our live webcams are available at the bottom of this page.

Please purchase tickets online prior to arrival. Sunrise has new RFID pass cards this season, so any previous pass cards will not work to reload. Once purchasing a pass online, just scan your confirmation at a Skiosk at the Ticket Office to retrieve your new pass. Season Passes are available for pickup at Guest Services (Day Lodge, Level 2). On-site sales will be available but may have extended wait times and additional fees.

Live Cameras

Sunrise Peak Live

Our live camera operates from the top of Sunrise Mountain at 10,700 feet. It has the ability to zoom in at the base as well as other areas around the mountain and does so on a schedule throughout the day. The live feed above starts at 7:00 am each day and runs until 5:30 pm.

Sunrise Base Live

NEW! Our live camera operates from the base of Sunrise Mountain at 9,300 feet. It has the ability to zoom in on the lifts, bunny hill, and tubing hill and does so on a schedule throughout the day. The live feed above starts at 7:00 am each day and runs until 5:30 pm.
